headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles made significant roster moves, while several teams dealt with injuries and roster changes. Here's a breakdown of the latest news.

Top MLB News
The Orioles bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Cam Sanders, who was traded from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. Additionally, left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort.

Injuries and Availability Impact
Several teams have been impacted by injuries. Zac Gallen of the Arizona Diamondbacks was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. Chris Martin of the Texas Rangers was also placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder impingement. Other teams have dealt with injuries to Nick Lodolo, William Kempner, Brandon Woodruff, Mike Yastrzemski, and Anthony Banda.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Orioles acquired Cam Sanders in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Brewers received Braden Shewmake from the Astros, while the White Sox traded Brandon Eisert and Jacob Gonzalez to the Pirates for Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Twins acquired Tommy Nance from the Blue Jays in exchange for Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
